title: Kondowole
description: Kondowole is a Malawi dish made with cassava flour, peanut stew paste. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Uses processed cassava flour only. Never consume inadequately processed raw cassava.

steps.instruction: Use commercially detoxified cassava flour. Add it steadily to hot water and beat into a thick elastic paste, never using raw or untreated cassava.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 8 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
